recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If CQI wants to revisit the current CodeableConcept/extensible binding or group-level placement, handle that with a new tracker because the present source reflects later final R5/R6 decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-17247 was a Published/Persuasive CQI change request raised against STU3 Measure asking for improvementNotation to be machine-readable, either as a code bound to known increase/decrease values or as a CodeableConcept extensibly bound to the current known values. The final resolution requested improvementNotation 0..1 code { increase, decrease } and adding the element to MeasureReport.
initial_application: SVN 14046, represented in git as e169985949ad77cfed6c6e86ee8036a90f98136e, explicitly included GF#17247 and changed Measure/MeasureReport source spreadsheets and examples so improvementNotation used code values such as increase. That historical STU3 application is not the current source shape because the resources were later refactored and revised.
additional_context: Measure and MeasureReport are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. Later CQI decisions changed the current conformance shape: FHIR-28936 added group-level Measure calculation metadata including Measure.group.improvementNotation as CodeableConcept, FHIR-31413 clarified why MeasureReport repeats the Measure improvementNotation, FHIR-49670 clarified Measure-to-MeasureReport group correspondence, FHIR-49922 moved calculation-characterizing elements to group level, and FHIR-50664 removed the deprecated root Measure and MeasureReport improvementNotation elements. FHIR-55366 later removed isModifier treatment from MeasureReport metadata. Current source therefore correctly carries Measure.group.improvementNotation and MeasureReport.group.improvementNotation as CodeableConcept with extensible bindings to the measure-improvement-notation value set, and MeasureReport says the value is populated from the corresponding Measure group. Zulip and Confluence searches found no contrary community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change was made because restoring root-level elements or narrowing CodeableConcept back to code would conflict with later applied CQI decisions and remove current extensibility.
